description: Shared ProofStudio types: JSON settings, the project document envelope that preserves unknown fields, and the REST API contract (OpenAPI).

Self-hosted ProofStudio browser integrations: proof form, authoring, form configuration, reusable forms, asset and font libraries, document import, project export, revision review, bulk generation and the integration modal, with their shared modules and baseline fonts.

Server-side ProofStudio plugins for ASP.NET Core hosts. Background removal (solid colour fill and opt-in photo subject detection) through Cutaway.BackgroundRemoval, served on the same route the ProofStudio editor calls.
Server-side .NET client for a hosted ProofStudio instance: B2B client-credential tokens, projects and published versions, and document generation jobs.
Optional local RFC 5545 recurrence adapter for standalone Flare Scheduler clients.
Generic calendar scheduling UI with provider-owned events and resource timelines composed from Flare components.

Adds an Archived area to the Umbraco Users section. Archive leavers so they leave the Users list and user pickers, keep their history, and record who archived whom, when and why. Archiving always disables the user and never deletes them.
.NET SDK for Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API: typed clients, host-agnostic webhook verification and dispatch, and AddWhatsAppCloudApi dependency injection registration with a built-in retry pipeline.
.NET server SDK for Pubb realtime publishing and private/presence channel authorization.

Server-side background removal for ASP.NET Core hosts of the ProofStudio editor: solid colour fill and opt-in photo subject detection through Cutaway.BackgroundRemoval, served on the same route the editor calls. Replaces the ProofStudio.Plugins package.
XML schema (XSD) describing XCGF archetypes (data types, equipments, entities, units, tasks) and the XCGF standard library (HLA-based data types, kinematic, signature and sensor equipments).
